case_title: PATRICK OWNES VS. ACE RELOCATION SYSTEMS, INC.ET AL

docket_entries.description: REMARK:RETURN MAIL BY POST OFFICE JULY-10-2023 ORDER OF DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION MAIL TO DEFENDANT(AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL RELOCATION SOLUTIONS,LLC)(ENVOLOPE MARKED:RETURN TO SENDER NOT DELIVERABLE AS ADDRESSED UNABLE TO FORWARD)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY OWNES, PATRICK AS TO DEFENDANT ACE RELOCATION SYSTEMS, INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-15-2023 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF OWNES, PATRICK AS TO DEFENDANT ACE RELOCATION SYSTEMS, INC.
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF OWNES, PATRICK AS TO DEFENDANT AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL RELOCATION SOLUTIONS,LLC

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF PATRICK OWNES IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM (AUDIO ONLY) APPEARANCE. DEFENDANT ACE RELOCATIONS SYSTEMS, INC IS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT AMERICAN INTERNATIONAL RELOCATION SOLUTIONS, LLC IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF DID NOT KNOW THAT HIS ATTEMPTED FILING OF DISMISSAL SENT IN TO THE CLERK'S OFFICE WAS REJECTED. THE COURT INFORMED THE PLAINTIFF THAT BECAUSE THIS WAS AN UNAUTHORIZED APPEARANCE AND THE COURT IS NOT AWARE OF THE REASON FOR THE REJECTION OF DISMISSAL, THE PLAINTIFF MUST FILE A DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE IF THAT IS PLAINTIFF'S INTENTION. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: SYLIVA L. HUSING; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITH PREJUDICE DISMISSAL FILED AFTER CASE WAS DISMISSED IN A COURTROOM.
